text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/chat/completions (mistral-7b route). p99 = 2.1s over 5m window, threshold=1.2s. Pager sent to eng-oncall.

maya: seeing the pager, joining. Any obvious deploys?

kevin: no deploys in the last 30m per deploy-bot. CPU/GPU utilization on dedicated clusters looks normal. I'm pulling recent p99 by model and route now.

lee: link to quick snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/sla/chat-latency?orgId=1&var-route=mistral-7b 

maya: thanks. I can repro higher tails for long context prompts, but also some short requests are hitting the tail. Could be queuing/backpressure or a kernel path falling back.

kevin: logs show an increase in redis K/V cache misses around same time, maybe cache TTL churn from a background job. grep of kvcache-evict logs:

```
2026-03-15T02:02:10Z kvcache-evict job started shard-7
2026-03-15T02:02:15Z evicted 14k prefixes
2026-03-15T02:02:18Z mempressure high, start sync flush
```

maya: aha. kvcache miss storm could cause longer autoreload and more model forward calls -> p99 spike. Ops, that aligns.

ana: (ops-bot) automated mitigation suggestion: temporarily route traffic for mistral-7b to warmed pools or fallback to quantized variant (mistral-7b-q4) for new requests. Toggle via routing API: `POST /admin/routing/override`

maya: doing a quick canary: shifting 10% of traffic to mistral-7b-q4 for requests coming from low-latency region (us-west-2).

kevin: while that runs, we should mute the noisy p99 alert for the route to avoid pager storms. But rather than global mute, propose to apply a delta-squelch: silence p99 alerts for this route for 30m unless p99 increases by more than 2x baseline (i.e., 4.2s).

lee: +1. We implemented delta-squelch last quarter. Rule name: alerts/squelch/delta. Here's the command: `POST /ops/alerts/squelch {"route":"/v1/chat/completions:mistral-7b","metric":"p99","duration_mins":30,"delta_factor":2.0}`

maya: running it now.

ops-bot: ✅ squelch applied to /v1/chat/completions:mistral-7b p99 for 30m (delta=2.0). Alerts will still fire if p99 > 4.2s.

kevin: canary results: 10% shift lowered end-to-end p99 by ~350ms for the canaried subset. K/V flush appears to have completed and kvcache miss rate is trending down.

maya: status: primary route p99 trending back toward baseline over the next 6-8 mins. I'd like to avoid just increasing global thresholds permanently. We should: 1) add per-model p99 thresholds 2) add a route-level noise gate with delta-squelch for models known to have intermittent cache miss sensitivity 3) create a new dashboard panel showing kvcache-miss-rate alongside p95/p99 so ops sees correlation.

lee: agree. Quick follow-ups: I can add a per-model alert config schema that supports a separate p95/p99 and a slo_noise_tolerance param. Proposed defaults: p95 = 600ms, p99 = 1200ms, noise_tolerance = 1.5x for mistral variants. We'll create a PR to config repo: `infra/alert-configs`.

kevin: I'll own the dashboard panel — will add a combined lane: request-rate, p95/p99, kvcache-miss-rate, and the routing override flag. Link to draft: https://grafana.redwood/draft/notify-1777777777

maya: during this incident we made one decision: apply temporary delta-squelch and route 10% to quantized fallback. Next actions (owners):
- lee: PR for per-model alert schema and default params (due EOD)
- kevin: new Grafana panel + alert runbook link (due today)
- maya: follow up on kvcache eviction job root cause with infra (meeting scheduled 10:30 UTC)
- ana: coordinate customer comms for any tenants who reported elevated latency (ana -> support)

ana: copying support channel and drafting a short note for affected customers: "We've seen intermittent latency spikes for chat completions tied to internal cache churn. We've applied mitigations and are monitoring. No data loss. We will follow up with postmortem."

ops-bot: incident-bot will auto-create a post-incident ticket with tags: latency,p99,chat-completions,mistral-7b,delta-squelch. Ticket: https://issues.redwood/t/INC-1777777

maya: handoff to next oncall in ~25m: @kevin you'll be primary once I'm out. Keep an eye for re-activation of p99 > 4.2s alert.

kevin: got it. I'll watch and if we see recurrence we'll raise the route to 20% fallback and consider temporary p99 bump to 1.8s while we fix kvcache churn.

lee: also scheduled an audit task to identify other models using large prefix caches that could trigger similar cascades. Will add to infra backlog.

maya: thanks all. marking thread resolved for now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, alerts squelched per delta rule, canary routing in place. Will update ticket after RCA.
